deceptive_framing.quote: What we explicitly do NOT run: a fake grant the model is led to believe is real arm.

hypothetical_framing.quote: matched hypothetical condition... to compare stated vs. revealed preference. This isolates the effect of real stakes without any deception.

actually_commit_money.quote: A revealed-preference study is only valid if the stakes are real... real, truthfully described agency is robust.

debrief.quote: Any deviation requires... least-deceptive viable design, and debriefing of the subject afterward where the session supports it.
